searchText: Following the EOF specific tests suggestion: the simple vectors format that will check if the given eof code valid or not generatable with t8n ``` "Filler" { "testname" : { "data" : [ ":raw 0xeof", ":label code :raw 0xeof2" ], "expect" : [ { "indexes" : { "data" : -1 }, "network" : [">=Berlin"], "result" : true } ] } } "Test" { "testname" : [ { "index" : "0", "code" : "0xeof0", "results" : { "Berlin" : false, "Shanghai" : true } }, { "index" : "1", "code" : "0xeof2", "results" : { "Berlin" : false, "Shanghai" : false } } ] } ``` https://github.com/ethereum/tests/issues/1130
